risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have a faulty motherboard.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and reaching the home screen.

risks.risk: The extruder may not heat or may have a clogged nozzle.
risks.proof: A video showing the nozzle heating up and successfully extruding a test line.

risks.risk: The filament may be used, contaminated, or the wrong material.
risks.proof: A photo of the filament spool with the label and a video showing the filament being fed.
risks.if_unproven: as used filament of unknown condition

risks.risk: The print bed may be warped or have uneven adhesion.
risks.proof: A photo of a test print on the bed.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new print bed

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and navigating the control panel.
Video of the extruder heating up and extruding a test line.
Photo of the filament spool label showing weight and material.
Photo of the print bed with a test print to check for flatness.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
